els.description: Built during the 1850's. The stone lock and traces of the dam still exist here.
els.name: Carysbrook Lock and Dam

els.description: Built in the 1920's. The lock's stone wall remains standing on the east bank. The crib dam has been reduces to rubble and creates the rapids found in this area.
els.name: White Rock Lock and Dam

els.description: Remains of a 19-foot high dam dating from the 1850's. On the north side of the river is the remains of the basement wall of the old flour mill.
els.name: Rivanna Mills Dam

els.description: Rock remains of bridge piers at Bryant's Ford.
els.name: Bridge piers at Bryant's Ford

els.description: The remains of Wood's Mill Dam form the rapids here.
els.name: Wood's Mill Dam

els.description: Built in the 1830's this lock was unique in that it had gates facing opposite directions to be able to seal off water from either the Rivanna connexion or Kanawha canals. One of the lock's stone walls is still visible on the south side of the river.
els.name: Columbia Junction Lock
